text.I used to cut my whole day into 15-minut: Nilikuwa nikikata siku yangu nzima katika vipande vya 15-dakika katika Notion na Kalenda ya Google, ili nisipoteze hata dakika moja.
🧱 Gridi ya dakika kumi na tano, baadaye.
text.In the end it did not work. So I gave up: Mwishowe haikufanya kazi. Kwa hivyo niliacha kujisimamia kikamilifu.
text.Burnham Park was a rare flat place to wa: Burnham Park ilikuwa sehemu tambarare adimu pa kutembea kwenye vilima vya Baguio
